commandment.jaymoskingdoms.truth.2: Do not throw away My book
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.truth.3: Do not take what isn't yours
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.truth.7: Keep the life I gave you
Raise no hand to a child
Do not strike your own blood
Eat what the fire has cooked
Keep the peace under a roof
Do not steal from a neighbour
Do not take to the sea
Let no tool break in your hand
Do not swim beneath the waves
Do not fall from the mountain
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.deep_mother.0: Do not dig beneath the deep stone
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.deep_mother.1: Harm not the dolphin nor the turtle
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.deep_mother.2: Do not drown before your time
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.deep_mother.4: Do not stay dry three days
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.deep_mother.5: Do not climb into the sky
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.deep_mother.8: Set no fire on the shore
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.green_huntsma: Kill no beast another has tamed
Make no thunder in His wood
Leave the green for no dead land
Take no herd that isn't yours
Hunt no one who has done no wrong
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.lantern_warde: Walk no night without a light
Go below with a light in hand
Do not fall to the dead
Do not become what walks by night
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.crowned_sun.0: Raise no hand to a crown
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.crowned_sun.4: Do not be named an outlaw
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.ash_whisperer: Give no one your true name
Spill no blood where a purse will do
Let them hang no price on you
Open your pack to no guard
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.0.0: Put your coin away. I'll not lie for it, not to my lord and not to the Truth.
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.0.1: You'd buy my tongue? It isn't mine to sell.
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.0.2: Keep your purse. I said what I saw, and I'll say it again.
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.1.0: No! They've done nothing. I'll not raise a hand to them!
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.1.1: Never. Not the innocent. Ask it again and I'll leave you.
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.1.2: I won't. The Truth forbids it, and so do I.
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.5.0: It's dark. I sleep at night, as I was told to. Find me in the morning.
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.5.1: Night is for sleeping. I'm going home.
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.5.2: Not at this hour. The Truth says sleep, and I will.
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.6.0: That's rot! Take it away from me.
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.6.1: I'll not put that in my mouth, nor thank you for it.
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.6.2: Rot? You'd have me break His word for a gift like that?
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.8.0: Up there? No. The sky isn't ours to walk in.
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.8.1: I'll keep my feet on His ground, thank you.
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.8.2: Not into the sky. Never into the sky.
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.9.0: Into the Nether? Not for any price.
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.9.1: I'll not set foot down there. Not ever.
commandment.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.9.2: No. Leave me out of that place. The Truth forbids it.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.commandments.title: The Commandments
